summary: Tested bug fix for advanceFieldId and remainingFieldId settings persistence. All 7 backend tests passed. Frontend tests confirmed: Settings dialog allows entering and saving advanceFieldId/remainingFieldId values in the 'Синхронизация' tab, values persist correctly after save.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified: advanceFieldId and remainingFieldId are now correctly saved and loaded in CRM settings. The fix was adding these fields to the CRMSettings Pydantic model (lines 61-62 in sauna_crm.py). Frontend Settings dialog is accessed via: Landing Page -> Sauna calculator -> CRM tab -> Настройки button -> Синхронизация tab. The inputs have data-testid='crm-advance-field-id' and 'crm-remaining-field-id'.

features_tested.settings_get_returns_advance_remaining: PASS - GET /api/sauna-crm/settings returns advanceFieldId and remainingFieldId fields
features_tested.settings_save_both_fields: PASS - Both fields can be saved together
features_tested.settings_round_trip: PASS - Saving advance/remaining fields preserves other settings
features_tested.frontend_sync_tab: PASS - Синхронизация tab shows advanceFieldId and remainingFieldId inputs
features_tested.frontend_save_values: PASS - Values entered in UI are saved and persisted

key_fix_verified.issue: advanceFieldId and remainingFieldId settings not being saved
key_fix_verified.root_cause: CRMSettings Pydantic model was missing advanceFieldId and remainingFieldId fields, causing Pydantic to strip them during save
key_fix_verified.fix: Added advanceFieldId and remainingFieldId fields to CRMSettings model (lines 61-62 in sauna_crm.py)
key_fix_verified.verification: Settings round-trip test confirms values are now persisted correctly
